go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

expected_findings.defect: Each goroutine appends to the shared `sizes` slice without synchronization, a data race that can lose results or corrupt the slice header.
expected_findings.rationale: `append` reads and writes the slice variable and may write the backing array. Concurrent unsynchronized appends from several goroutines are a data race under the Go memory model.

false_positive_traps.wrong_finding: The goroutine captures the loop variable `u`, so every goroutine may read the last URL.
false_positive_traps.why_wrong: Both trees declare go 1.22. Since Go 1.22 a `for` statement with `:=` declares a new `u` for each iteration, so each goroutine reads its own URL.
